title: 197 integrated JBMC preserving and discriminating array pairs
description: Try the full shared nullable profile first on equivalent implementations and on a skipped write, using the two-root poststate. Require a complete non-vacuous proof and a refutation with a JVM replay of both requested descriptors. If the full profile does not qualify, try a separately identified distinct-array domain with a one-cell bound, preserving every full-profile refusal.
expected: At least one declared profile qualifies both pairs at identical settings.
